preconditions: An I2C bus must be configured before probing the device.
Any board-level wake or power-hold wiring should already be stable.
steps: Open the I2C target at the configured address.
Read a status or time register to confirm the device responds.
Apply any project-local timezone or wake-alarm defaults after probe success.

validationHooks.description: Probe the configured I2C address and confirm an ACK is received.
validationHooks.passCriteria: The device acknowledges on the configured I2C address.
failureNotes: A missing ACK usually indicates the bus is not powered or the address is wrong.

validationHooks.description: Read a known RTC register to verify bus-level communication.
validationHooks.passCriteria: The RTC returns readable register data over I2C.
failureNotes: Readable but invalid time data should be treated as present but unconfigured.

checks: Probe the configured I2C address and confirm an ACK is received.
Read a known RTC register to verify bus-level communication.
smokeTest.passCriteria: The device acknowledges on I2C and returns readable register data.
failureNotes: A missing ACK usually indicates the bus is not powered or the address is wrong.
Readable but invalid time data should be treated as present but unconfigured.

highLevel.name: rtc_get_time
highLevel.description: Read current wall-clock time from the RTC.

highLevel.name: rtc_set_time
highLevel.description: Write a new wall-clock time into the RTC.

highLevel.name: rtc_configure_alarm
highLevel.description: Configure a wake or alarm event using board-local policy.
